items.period: Seal-script style as represented in a modern digital drawing; not a securely dated artifact
items.caption: Modern digital redraw of 花 in a Shuowen seal-script style, associated on Commons with a source record for 華. It illustrates a received dictionary-style form, not an excavated early 花 inscription.
items.alt: Black outlined seal-style 花 character on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description page supplies a specific image, identifies its source association, and documents reuse terms. It can illustrate a later received graphic tradition while making clear that it is not an ancient artifact photo.
items.rights: Public domain, according to the Commons file description for this SVG representation.

limitations.text: The candidate direct SVG URL returned an internal error when opened directly. Its Commons source page was successfully inspected and identifies the image and public-domain status. The graphic is a modern redraw; no ancient bronze or manuscript image with checked provenance and reuse terms was established in this search.
